title: Behavior-preserving refactoring sweep with parity gates

steps.action: Freeze the behavioral baseline: the existing test suite and golden snapshots are the parity contract for the refactor
Sweep the whole codebase for the same pattern, not just the reported site; three or more同类 sites become one codemod wave
Apply the change as pure structure moves; any behavior difference must be a separate, explicitly justified change
Re-run the full affected suite and the parity gates; a green narrow test alone does not close a cross-cutting refactor

decision_hooks.criteria: The dispatched task refactors, deduplicates, or restructures existing working code
